answer: In Proof of Agent, each evaluator’s trust contribution decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so reputation requires sustained, consistently honest service rather than a single successful interaction. EigenTrust normalization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity assign freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; like a comet, quill, or ivory token without established links, they cannot accumulate enough support to pass consensus.
